versions.content: If the configuration parameter WdgMDevErrorDetect [ ECUC_WdgM_00301 ] is disabled : The function WdgM_GetLocalStatus shall return without any effect if the Watchdog Manager is in WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_DEACTIVATED .
